function.name: PLAY_WAV
function.param: Identifier of the sound returned by LOAD_WAV

description.p: It reproduces a sound effect recovered previously of disk by the function . It is possible to reproduce sometimes a same effect of simultaneous form. This function returns a identifier of the channel of sound used to reproduce the sound effect. There are 16 channels of sound avaliable for effects, and this function can choose any of them that are free. In case of reproducing a great amount of sound effects simultaneously, it is possible that in a while there will be 16 active sounds, in which case the new sound will not be reproduced and this function will return -1.
The identifier of channel returned by this function can be used with , , and other functions of sound.

The sound effect can be reproduced one time, two times... if the parameter of repeats is 0, 1, 2... or it can be reproduced all time if this parameter is -1. We must know that if the sound is reproduced all time, the channel, which is used by the sound, always will be occupied unless the sound stops by the function .
